entities.description: A full-body shot of a standing Black man with a lean build, wearing traditional African attire including a beaded headband with a feather, a red and blue beaded necklace with a pendant, and a fringed skirt made of light-colored material with red vertical stripes. He is barefoot with white anklets and stands on sandy ground against a background of dried grass.

clothing.headwear: beaded headband with red, white, and black beads and a single dark feather
clothing.necklace: long beaded necklace with alternating red and blue beads and a light-colored oval pendant
clothing.lower_body: fringed skirt with vertical red stripes on a beige or light tan background, tied at the waist with a white cord
clothing.anklets: white beaded or corded anklets on both ankles
